name: Allow + unspecified resource scope (no Resource and no NotResource)
note: S1-shape-failclosed regression. An identity Allow (no Principal/NotPrincipal) names an Action but omits BOTH Resource and NotResource, so its resource scope is UNSPECIFIED. AWS requires a Resource element on an identity statement; with neither key the model collapses to resources:[] and resourceIsBroad(rules.js) reads it as NARROW, suppressing WILDCARD-RESOURCE / bulk-read DATA-EXFIL - a silent fail-OPEN. The presence flag resourcePresent distinguishes this from the benign explicit empty set Resource:[]. The shared engine must mark coverage INCOMPLETE (UNSPECIFIED_RESOURCE_SCOPE) so neither surface reports a clean pass.
